name: @qti-pie/processing
description: QTI 3.0.1 processing as one pure, effect-free TypeScript evaluator: the value model, the typed program compiled from a stored document, every operator, and response, outcome and template processing, whose only grade is a Graded result the evaluator mints.

scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'toolchain-typecheck -p src/tsconfig.json "$@" & toolchain-typecheck -p tsconfig.json "$@"; source=$?; wait $! && exit $source' typecheck
scripts.test: mkdir -p work/.vp-tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/work/.vp-tmp" NODE_OPTIONS="$NODE_OPTIONS --disable-proto=delete --disable-sigusr1" vitest run
